audit.title: PerfLens Final Post-Completion Forensic QA Audit

focusAreasAudit.name: Target Website Measurement Reality
focusAreasAudit.verified: Dedicated Puppeteer browser instance created per scan navigating to target URL. Analyzers receive genuine live DOM page context.

focusAreasAudit.name: Absence of Hardcoded/Default/Mock Values
focusAreasAudit.verified: Grepped all production pipelines. Zero fake vitals or default scores found; all numbers trace to CDP/NavigationTiming/Lighthouse audits.

focusAreasAudit.name: Stale Cache Contamination Prevention
focusAreasAudit.verified: DB PageSpeed telemetry enforces 15-minute TTL; browser crawler uses ephemeral browser contexts with complete post-scan cleanup.

focusAreasAudit.name: Puppeteer Page/Session Distribution
focusAreasAudit.verified: Orchestrator securely passes active page and crawl data across image, CSS, JS, SEO, and A11y analyzers with independent try/catch error shielding.

focusAreasAudit.name: PageSpeed/Lighthouse/CrUX Source Labeling
focusAreasAudit.verified: Clear source attribution ('lighthouse' vs 'crux' vs 'puppeteer') and mode ('lab' vs 'field'). INP explicitly labeled as crux/field or puppeteer/lab/unrated.

focusAreasAudit.name: Fallback Behavior on PageSpeed 429/Timeout
focusAreasAudit.verified: Network errors, timeouts (20s), and HTTP 429 status codes safely catch, returning null and gracefully triggering Puppeteer lab vitals mode without throwing.

focusAreasAudit.name: Unavailable != Zero Handling
focusAreasAudit.verified: classifyMetric treats null/undefined/NaN as isAvailable: false, rating: 'unrated', score: null. Valid 0 (e.g. CLS = 0) is classified as good/score: 100.

focusAreasAudit.name: LCP/CLS/INP Core Web Vitals Correctness
focusAreasAudit.verified: LCP captures element selector/timing; CLS implements standard W3C session window algorithm; INP is never fabricated or simulated.

focusAreasAudit.name: TBT Tracing to Actual Long Tasks
focusAreasAudit.verified: PerformanceObserver longtask buffering aggregates blocking duration (>50ms per task), tracking script URLs, max duration, and long task count.

focusAreasAudit.name: TTFB Measurement Validity
focusAreasAudit.verified: Navigation timing responseStart - requestStart (or Lighthouse server-response-time) correctly measured in milliseconds.

focusAreasAudit.name: JS/CSS/Image/Network/Bundle Resource Extraction
focusAreasAudit.verified: CDP Network domain captures transfer sizes, decoded body sizes, compression status, mime types, and unused code percentages.

focusAreasAudit.name: SEO Findings Backed by DOM Evidence
focusAreasAudit.verified: Queries document title, meta description, viewport, headings, and lang attribute directly from DOM with exact selectors and values.

focusAreasAudit.name: Accessibility Findings Backed by DOM Evidence
focusAreasAudit.verified: DOM queries inspect missing img alt, input labels, button accessible names, retaining specific element selectors. 0 fake savings assigned.

focusAreasAudit.name: Recommendations Backed by Findings
focusAreasAudit.verified: All 21 recommendation rules evaluate concrete findings before generating actionable remediation items.

focusAreasAudit.name: Quantified Savings Backed by Explicit Model
focusAreasAudit.verified: TRANSFER_ONLY estimate model uses explicit 200 KB/s bandwidth transfer model with explicit non-milestone disclaimer.

focusAreasAudit.name: Score Calculations Using Canonical Analyzer Data
focusAreasAudit.verified: Performance scores derived via weighted harmonic models. Missing metrics are excluded from active weight denominator, preventing false penalties.

focusAreasAudit.name: JSON -> DB -> API -> Frontend -> PDF Consistency
focusAreasAudit.verified: Complete end-to-end data pipeline preserves identical numeric values, ratings, breakdown arrays, and recommendation IDs across all targets.

focusAreasAudit.name: Security and SSRF Protection
focusAreasAudit.verified: ssrfValidator blocks RFC 1918 subnets, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), hex/decimal encodings, IPv6 loopbacks, and DNS rebinding.

focusAreasAudit.name: Repeatability Across Fresh Scans
focusAreasAudit.verified: Identical classifications and ratings verified across repeated runs on example.com with 0 rating flips or metric drift.

defectInventory.observedBehavior: IPageSpeedMetrics did not explicitly type inpSource or inpMode properties, causing analysis/index.ts to infer 'crux' based solely on inpClass.isAvailable.
defectInventory.expectedBehavior: Telemetry data should explicitly attach inpSource ('crux' | 'lighthouse' | 'unknown') and inpMode ('field' | 'lab') directly from the PageSpeed response.
defectInventory.evidence: Analysis fallback inferred source = crux whenever INP was available, which was true for PageSpeed CrUX percentile but lacked explicit property typing.
defectInventory.reproduction: Inspect IPageSpeedMetrics interface and analysis/index.ts line 289.
defectInventory.rootCause: Omission of optional inpSource and inpMode fields on IPageSpeedMetrics contract.
defectInventory.recommendedFix: Add inpSource and inpMode to IPageSpeedMetrics and populate them during audit extraction.

defectInventory.observedBehavior: Suspected TTI substitution or simulated lab INP values.
defectInventory.expectedBehavior: INP must remain unrated with null score in lab Puppeteer mode and never substitute TTI.
defectInventory.evidence: Audited analysis/index.ts line 535: INP is explicitly score: null, rating: 'unrated', available: false. Zero occurrences of TTI substitution.
defectInventory.reproduction: Scan non-interactive page via Puppeteer fallback mode.

defectInventory.observedBehavior: Suspected that CLS = 0.000 might be treated as missing or failing.
defectInventory.expectedBehavior: CLS = 0.000 is a perfect score and must be classified as 'good' with score 100.
defectInventory.evidence: classifyMetric('cls', 0) returns isAvailable: true, rating: 'good', score: 100. Confirmed on example.com, news.ycombinator.com, react.dev.
